evaluation_protocol.original: 8 single-GPU replicas, concurrency32 per replica, temperature0.7, 200iterations, task7200s, PI disabled
evaluation_protocol.supplement: Only infrastructure-review or unresolved-verifier cases; concurrency1 per GPU, same sampling and budgets, independent new trajectories
evaluation_protocol.replacement_policy: At the user's request, replace every selected task's original verdict with its supplemental verdict; do not add passes already present or choose the better verdict
evaluation_protocol.replacement_scope: Derived diagnostic aggregation; original result files remain unchanged

limitations: Original runs contain execution failures, task-budget exhaustion and, for steps30/50, one unresolved verdict each.
Replacement aggregation mixes original and low-concurrency stochastic trajectories; it is not a uniform full500 rerun.
Saved baseline runs also contain exceptions and unresolved verdicts; the comparison does not establish a causal PI gain.
No model weights, datasets, checkpoints, logs, raw trajectories or local deployment evidence are included in this record.
conclusion: The best observed PI checkpoint is step30. These evaluations do not establish an improvement over the saved SAO baseline.
